en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. The castle has thick stone walls, multiple steeply pitched roofs with small dormers, conical corner towers, and a dominant central keep rising above the rest of the buildings. Ivy climbs one side of the main tower. In the foreground are trees and a few smaller houses with sloped roofs, while a winding path or road leads up toward the castle on the right. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
